source.credit: Mottola et al. (2023), The Planetary Science Journal 4, 18, Table 3

constraints.axisConvention: Full axes are halved exactly. +Z is the adopted pole; +X is the arbitrary display meridian.
constraints.qualification: Authored ellipsoid approximation constrained to the published convex model's maximum extents. These are not independently measured ellipsoid axes; the irregular convex outline and model volume are not reproduced.
constraints.scale: The reference radius is the geometric mean of the approximation semiaxes. It is a rendering scale, not an independent measured mean radius or convex-model volume.

assumptions: Authored ellipsoid approximation constrained to the published convex model's maximum extents. These are not independently measured ellipsoid axes; the irregular convex outline and model volume are not reproduced.
Published retrograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude.
approximation.qualification: Observation-constrained ellipsoid; no invented local terrain or albedo.

spin.meaning: Published retrograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude.

unresolved: The original 1454-facet convex reconstruction was not located in the checked paper's supporting release.
The paper's 69.3 km surface-equivalent diameter is not a volume-equivalent diameter and is not used to rescale this approximation.
